title: Random Acts of Randomness
pov: Oliver（31 岁）→ Zach（约 2/3 处起）

facts.fact: 抬头：2036 年 9 月 1 日星期一（劳动节），Zach 35 岁，Oliver 31 岁
facts.quote: Monday, September 1, 2036 (Zach is 35, Oliver is 31)

facts.fact: Oliver 没有回避 Zach 也没有主动找他；Haymarket 纪念会枪击对他只是几个月前；他睡不好、醒来就恐慌、酒喝多了
facts.quote: For me, the shooting at the Haymarket memorial was just a few months ago, and I don't know how to talk with him about it.

facts.fact: Alba 事先把枪击会如何发生、他该说什么做什么都告诉他了；他像不情愿的演员照本走，从未觉得如此不自由——像在演奏既存的音乐
facts.quote: Alba told me exactly how the shooting would unfold, told me what to say, what to do, what to expect:

facts.fact: 他提着空购物袋走在 Lincoln Avenue 去 Trader Joe's；Zach 在街对面喊他，穿过几乎不动的车流跑过来；Zach 更瘦、气色不好
facts.quote: Now I'm walking down Lincoln Avenue with my empty shopping bags, headed for Trader Joe's

facts.fact: 两人到街角酒吧的户外桌，坐大橡树荫下；天很热、晴朗的劳动节；Oliver 点了 Pimm's，端上来一大杯带水果和黄瓜片的褐色液体
facts.quote: There's a bar on the corner, and we are led to an outdoor table under the shade of a huge oak tree.

facts.fact: Zach 说上次见面 Oliver 救了他的命，他一直没道谢；事后找过 Oliver，但他不在
facts.quote: You saved my life the last time I saw you, and I never got to thank you.

facts.fact: Zach 说 Gomez（那位市议员）死了；他常梦见 Gomez，梦里 Gomez 不理他、转过身去
facts.quote: "He won't talk to me. He turns his back."

facts.fact: Oliver 说他做过这种梦，但梦里的不是 Gomez，而是他的父母——他没能救的人
facts.quote: In my dreams it is my parents who reproach me, who I failed to save.

facts.fact: Zach 追问 Oliver 那天为什么在场；Oliver 说他提过老板要演讲、自己在市区看到新闻就去了，然后无人机出现
facts.quote: "You invited me; or maybe you just mentioned that your boss was giving a speech?

facts.fact: Zach 说这太像天意、不像偶然；若不是 Oliver 抓住他，他肯定死了
facts.quote: "It seemed too providential to be random," Zach says, "you suddenly being there. I'm sure I would be dead if you hadn't grabbed me."

facts.fact: Zach 说他无法相信一个会救他、却让 Gomez 死的神；宇宙由 random acts of randomness 组成
facts.quote: the universe consists of random acts of randomness

facts.fact: Oliver 回应：为世界增加善永远不会无意义；艺术增加喜悦的总量，音乐抵消恶，我们储存喜悦以对抗坏时光
facts.quote: "It's like music—people ask what art is for; I think it adds to the sum total of joy, and joy is good. Music offsets evil. We store up joy against bad times."

facts.fact: Caralora 到场：高个金发、戴宽檐软帽、裙子让他想起 Dorothy Lamour；Madeline 刚满八十，仍很矫健
facts.quote: "Caralora, there you are."

facts.fact: Oliver 从 Alba 口中听过很多 Caralora 的事，知道得比该知道的多；他意识到这张桌上的三人构成 Alba 全部的情欲生活，而另两人毫不知情
facts.quote: I realize that the three of us at this table represent Alba's entire erotic life and that neither Zach nor Caralora are aware of this

facts.fact: Caralora 说 You look familiar；Zach 介绍 Oliver 就是从无人机下救他的人；她说她当时没看见他
facts.quote: She squints at me, gives me the once-over. "You look familiar."

facts.fact: Oliver 解释他尽快离开，是为了避免穿越回自己时代时在原地留下一堆衣服
facts.quote: I got out of there quickly so I wouldn't leave a telltale pile of clothing behind when I traveled back to my own time.

facts.fact: Caralora 邀他参加当晚在选区办公室的劳动节派对，会上将颁发 Gomez 的选民以他名义资助的新奖学金；Oliver 推说已答应妻子去烧烤，并谎称要带 coleslaw
facts.quote: "We're having a Labor Day party at the ward office tonight, you should come by.

facts.fact: 离开后他一路跑到超市，在冷冻食品柜前盯着冰淇淋站了很久，直到觉得自己实体稳固
facts.quote: I arrive at the grocery store panting and panicked, and spend a long time in the frozen food aisle staring at cleverly packaged ice cream before I feel solid enough to carry on with my day.

facts.fact: Zach 段：Caralora 说刚才那人很怪——她来时以为 Zach 带的是 Alba（黑长发），转身才知不是；她说 Oliver 有很多 Alba 的小动作，两人像同卵双胞胎
facts.quote: The long black hair. But then he turned around, and I realized it was someone else. But, he has a lot of Alba's mannerisms, don't you think? It's uncanny. They're like identical twins.

facts.fact: Caralora 给 Zach 一颗草莓，味道和半小时前 Oliver 给他的一模一样
facts.quote: It tastes exactly like the strawberry Oliver gave me half an hour ago.

facts.fact: Zach 查过 Oliver：姓 Thornton-Yang，一无所获——He doesn't exist
facts.quote: "I mean I couldn't find any trace of him. He doesn't exist."

facts.fact: Caralora 问这让你想起谁，Zach 答 Us，她补 Us, guided by Alba；她又提醒有人也想杀 Zach，不只是 Gomez
facts.quote: "Us, guided by Alba. How likely is it that he's never met Alba?"

facts.fact: Zach 说 Oliver 住伦敦、妻子住在这里、他只是来访；他没见过她、连名字都记不住
facts.quote: "London. His wife lives here, he just visits."

facts.fact: Caralora 警告：你在跟一个谁都查不到的人混，会把我们都害死；她说让她来查
facts.quote: You're hanging out with someone you can't research, who doesn't seem to be known by anyone we know. You're going to get us all killed, mister.

facts.fact: Zach 认识 Oliver 已几年；几周后 Caralora 说她也没查到，Oliver 正式是个幽灵；Zach 反而高兴，之后不再追问私事
facts.quote: She says she got nowhere: Oliver is officially a phantom.

turning_point: 本章转折点＝Caralora 当面指出 Oliver 与 Alba 像同卵双胞胎、且查无此人，Zach 却选择不再追查（He's my friend. I want that to be enough.）；已进清单（第 19、21、23、24 条）。
